Join Durham’s Research Community
At Durham University, you will become part of a vibrant and inclusive research community, working alongside leading academics to address some of the world's most pressing challenges.
Whether you are considering a PhD, Masters by Research or Professional Doctorate, Durham offers the expertise, facilities and supportive environment to help you realise your research ambitions and make a meaningful contribution to your field.
Explore our Academic Departments
Apply now
Research excellence
Durham University is a Russell Group university whose research addresses some of society's most pressing challenges. In REF 2021, the majority of Durham's research was assessed as world-leading or internationally excellent, reflecting our global reputation for research excellence. Explore Research Excellence.
Join a global research community
Durham's postgraduate researchers come from across the world, creating an international and collaborative research environment supported through dedicated immigration, wellbeing and academic services.
Research programmes
Whether you are looking to apply for a PhD, Masters by Research or Professional Doctorate, we have a Research degree for you. Explore our research.
PhD
A PhD provides the opportunity to make an original contribution to knowledge through independent research under the guidance of expert supervisors. Researchers typically complete their studies in three to four years full-time or five to seven years part-time.
Masters by Research (MRes)
Research Masters programmes allow students to undertake supervised independent research while developing advanced research skills. These programmes can provide excellent preparation for doctoral study or research-based careers.
Professional Doctorates
Professional Doctorates are designed for experienced professionals seeking to conduct research within their professional practice while making a significant contribution to their field.
Funding, fees and planning your research degree
We encourage prospective researchers to find the right supervisor, and consider fees and funding opportunities.
Funding and scholarships
We offer a range of funding opportunities including:
Durham University Scholarships
Studentships
Doctoral Training Partnerships (DTPs)
Centres for Doctoral Training (CDTs)
International Funding Schemes
We encourage applicants to explore funding opportunities early as many schemes have application deadlines before programme start dates.
Explore funding and scholarships
Fees and costs
Understanding the cost of doctoral study
When planning your doctoral studies you should consider:
Tuition fees
Living expenses
Accommodation
Research expenses
Conference attendance
Fieldwork costs where applicable
Tuition fees and charges
Find a supervisor
Finding the right supervisor is one of the most important steps in planning your research degree.
We encourage prospective researchers to engage with departments and identify academics whose expertise aligns with their research interests before submitting an application.
Before applying, we encourage you to:
Read recent publications
Develop a short research outline
Introduce yourself and your research interests
Discuss supervisory fit and project feasibility
Find a supervisor

Durham Business School
At Durham University Business School, we believe that to succeed in business, you need to get closer to the realities of business. So that’s what we do. We connect students and alumni with global companies, and we link businesses with incisive and innovative thinking.

Faculty of Arts and Humanities
We nurture thoughtful, critical and engaged citizens for a rapidly changing and complex world. Our six departments and one school produce highly-ranked and influential research within and across disciplines, languages, and cultures.

Faculty of Science
The Faculty of Science is home to a diverse community of staff and students across eight academic Departments. We are recognised for research impact that directly benefits society. Our eight departments are responsible for postgraduate teaching, as well as world-leading research that seeks to empower and inspire.

Faculty of Social Sciences
Our nine departments and schools are engaged in pioneering research and innovative learning. We are regularly ranked within the world's top 50 for the quality and significance of our research, our students enjoy an unparalleled learning experience, and our graduates are some of the most sought-after by employers.

360° virtual tour
Take a tour of key sites across the University and city. Get a feel for Durham before you arrive or take a virtual tour of our Departments, complete with helpful videos and interactive elements.
Using mobile? We recommend viewing the virtual tour directly to make the most of the 360 functionality. Take a virtual tour on your mobile.
Durham's collegiate difference. More than a university experience.
Durham's unique collegiate system provides a strong sense of community alongside your academic department.
Colleges offer opportunities to build friendships, develop leadership skills and engage in cultural, sporting and volunteering activities. Discover Our Colleges.
